purpose: Operator management of the platform's opaque JSON feature-flag registry and its recent audited changes.
primaryGoal: Review current values and type composition; create, edit or delete a flag with an audit reason and the existing server sudo challenge.

dataSources.ownership: Registry hook owns cancellable reads; apiflagsh handler and configured FlagStore own backend registry.
dataSources.behavior: Shared list key; moderate stale time, standard interval, no background interval, retry 1; abort signal forwarded. Page uses flags.data.flags, not response count.

dataSources.ownership: Separate audit hook; backend FeatureFlagChangesRepo supplied to apiflagsh handler.
dataSources.behavior: Latest returned global subset only, not lifetime or workspace-range totals. Encoded per-key history URL also exists in this hook but this page calls only global history.

dataSources.ownership: Mutation hook owns toast and shared invalidation; client owns live-mode guard and sudo replay; server owns write authorization and audit.
dataSources.behavior: JSON body {value, reason}; requiresLiveMode true; invalidates system/flags prefix and per-key entry; canceled sudo is silently handled. Not exercised.
Mandatory trimmed reason; live-only write; same invalidation/toast handling. Not exercised.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Reuse title, subtitle, primaryAction, query and named dataSources; full-width min-w-0 container; PageContainer owns header trust notice, freshness and page fallback.

components.name: LayoutCard / SectionErrorBoundary / FadeIn
components.contract: Retain independent registry/composition/audit shells, title associations and error boundaries. Existing FadeIn delegates OS/low-bandwidth motion preference; do not add another animation system.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Preserve columns, tableId, sorting, value filters, local pagination and built-in export/persistence. Existing mobilePresentation / expandable renderExpanded and column exportValue provide reuse paths, not a replacement table.

components.name: FeatureFlagsOperationalBrief / OperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: Six raw count metrics; independent unknown/retained source context; provenance and Review details stay. Existing shared bridge handles saved display preferences.

components.name: MetricBar
components.contract: Use label, numeric value/max, color and optional fill='solid'; null remains no reading; shared progressbar semantics and reduced motion remain. No new composition renderer needed.

components.name: Drawer / Modal / Input / Textarea / Button
components.contract: Keep canonical field identity/help/error semantics and overlay focus/scroll/close behavior. Page caller can guard onClose during pending save without another dialog engine.

components.name: deriveDataState / sourceStatus / sourceFreshness
components.contract: Retained payload survives refresh errors; fatal error replaces only never-loaded source; paused refresh is stale, not zero. Source labels remain independent.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Identical provenance text is supplied to OperationalBrief and repeated directly below at line 73. Existing legacy FlagStatsBand independently computes the same six metric categories and remains barrel-exported; it is not mounted by this page.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep canonical OperationalBrief and one deliberately placed visible provenance explanation; reconcile legacy band only in separately assigned ownership after checking consumers.

responsive.strategy: One-column sections until xl, then registry spans two of three columns. Both tables use stable mobile allow-lists; drawer is full width below sm; deletion actions wrap.

issues.detail: Mobile list includes only changed_at, actor, operation. Key, old/new value and reason are hidden below md by DataTable's hidden md:table-cell policy. This caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable details, so the audit event identity and explanation lack a source-confirmed mobile read path.
issues.fix: Reuse DataTable mobilePresentation with full-detail disclosure, or expandable details retaining all seven columns and long values; keep tableId and exports. Do not just hide audit metadata.

issues.detail: Actions are a non-wrapping flex row alongside unbroken key and JSON text; all three columns remain on phones. Table-local scrolling is supported, but source does not prove reachability or comfortable targets at 320px and with long translations.
issues.fix: Use existing mobile table contract and wrapping action labels; preserve key/value/edit/delete rather than removing columns. Validate container width and long-key cases.

sourceStrengths: Shared field labels/required and parse error props
Composition list and labeled MetricBar progressbars

issues.detail: Registry previews truncate at 120 characters. Audit compact() separately truncates old/new values at 60 characters (ChangesPanel.tsx:45-52). Neither table provides an expanded full-value read surface; registry editing exposes current JSON but is not a read-only alternative and cannot recover the previous audit value.
issues.fix: Keep compact previews and provide keyboard-accessible read-only full JSON detail using the existing Drawer or DataTable expansion. Preserve null as JSON null and opaque data text without recasing.

accessibility.reducedMotion: source reuse confirmed; actual motion unverified

states.initialLoading: Registry/audit use loading emptyMessage in DataTable, not a contextual skeleton or table busy prop. Composition has five-line Skeleton; summary loading is true only when both feeds are initial.
states.empty: Registry explanatory empty message; audit EmptyState; composition EmptyState; known empty feeds produce legitimate zero counts.
states.fatalError: Independent QueryError retry for registry, composition and audit plus summary source retries; sections remain mounted.
states.refreshError: Page uses fatalError only, preserving cached rows. Summary exposes refresh-error alert and retained indication; PageContainer also receives named sources.
states.offlineStale: deriveDataState marks retained paused reads stale; summary labels independent sources. No network or offline scenario exercised.
states.unknown: Summary uses null counts when feed has not supplied data; successful missing arrays are normalized to empty by existing behavior.
states.mutation: Save failure keeps drawer open by catch; delete failure keeps modal open. Server sudo and client live-mode guard retained.

issues.detail: Editor onClose unconditionally clears editing/open while setFlag is pending. FlagEditDrawer disables only footer Cancel; Drawer invokes onClose from header Close, scrim and shared Escape handling. Delete modal already guards onClose during pending. A pending save can therefore outlive its dismissed editor, unlike deletion.
issues.fix: Guard the page editor onClose while setFlag.isPending and preserve input until the existing mutation settles; do not bypass sudo or introduce a new cancellation/mutation mechanism. Test Close/scrim/Escape during save and reauth.

issues.detail: Table loading is represented only by emptyMessage; registry does the same at FlagsTable.tsx:172. DataTable does not receive loading, and PageLayout receives neither loading nor busy, so page aria-busy is not driven by these feeds. Composition/summary already have independent designed loading states.
issues.fix: Reuse localized contextual Skeleton within each table source on first load and shared busy announcement contracts; never replace retained rows during refresh or gate the whole page.

visualIssues.detail: Six page-owned hex accents include bright cyan/purple and are passed to MetricBar with its default gradient fill. Page card icons also hardcode text-cyan-300 (FeatureFlagsPage.tsx:154,175,191). No actual contrast/visual measurement made.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current restrained theme/semantic palette and MetricBar fill='solid' where appropriate; neutralize purely decorative icons. Preserve type labels/counts/percentages and user theme choices.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature directly imports Text from @/components/ui/Typography instead of the category barrel used for its other primitives.
architectureIssues.fix: Import Text from the existing @/components/ui barrel; no shared export or new wrapper needed.

architectureIssues.detail: Old/new value columns render truncated compact strings and supply no exportValue. Registry value similarly renders truncated preview. DataTable prefers rendered text for CSV (DataTable.tsx:884-893), so CSV uses previews instead of complete stored JSON. JSON export follows raw values for supported types; do not claim both formats are truncated.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply complete canonical JSON exportValue for these opaque value columns using existing DataTable contract; retain preview formatting, table IDs and loaded-subset scope. Validate null, booleans, arrays, nested objects, quotes/newlines and long strings.

architectureIssues.detail: Freshness uses new Date(updatedAt).toLocaleString() without the app's formatting bridge, selecting host/browser defaults rather than explicitly following saved display preferences. This dependency is shared by nearby admin briefs, so it is not an exclusive page edit.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the assigned integration owner reuse the existing formatting hook/preferences for fetched timestamps, retaining localized unknown freshness and epoch input; no new formatter.

first: Recover full-value read and CSV export paths
priority.reason: Existing section/data trust architecture is strong; remaining issues concern complete operator evidence, pending writes and presentation consistency, not a page replacement.

sharedChangeAssessment: No new shared component or public API is justified by this bounded audit. Existing DataTable detail/export contracts, MetricBar solid fill and shared Drawer are sufficient. sourceMetadata freshness normalization is an integration-owned dependency follow-up, not permission for this worker to edit it.

competingImplementations.name: Legacy FlagStatsBand versus mounted FeatureFlagsOperationalBrief
competingImplementations.detail: Legacy MetricCard band repeats six metric calculations and remains exported by index.ts:4, but FeatureFlagsPage imports the OperationalBrief directly instead. No claim of global dead code; consumer graph outside the assigned page was not audited.
competingImplementations.resolution: Retain mounted canonical stats bridge; report legacy coexistence without deleting unassigned consumers.

preservation.lineCountBasis: 270 page + 181 FlagsTable + 173 ChangesPanel + 129 composition + 177 editor + 77 OperationalBrief; excludes unmounted legacy band and shared owners.
overlays: OperationalBrief Review details uses its existing shared drawer
dataBehavior: Never change opaque stored JSON value meaning, including null/false/zero.
Current registry and recent limit-50 audit subset remain separate; counts are not lifetime totals.
Contributor metric counts distinct nonempty trimmed actors; structured counts object plus array; boolean counts both true and false.
Retain independent fatal versus background-refresh errors, retained rows, null unknown metrics, last-success metadata and retries.
Keep query keys, polling, cancellation, retry/stale policy, mutation invalidation and source ownership.
Keep live-only write guard, encoded keys/reasons, mandatory audit reason, server sudo/reauth replay, and toast behavior.
Do not add a date/vehicle selector: workspaceScope excludes /admin/flags from range ownership and disables vehicle for /admin.
No physical SI conversion is involved: feature values are opaque JSON and metrics are counts. Do not infer units for stored numbers.
Retain shared localization, formatting, reduced-motion, theme IDs, table persistence and auth/session boundaries.
